title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Corp., files for review and approval of a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Boston College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed aggrement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 00-35).
